name: elagoht/secure
description: A collage plugin that sends the security headers a site should, and a Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces.
setup:
Works on its own: `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy`, and HSTS over HTTPS.
For a Content-Security-Policy, set `"csp": "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-{nonce}'"` in `plugins-config.json` and write each inline script as `<script nonce="{{cspNonce}}">`.
With a nonce, also set `"keyEnv": "SECURE_KEY"` there, and `SECURE_KEY=` (`openssl rand -hex 32`) in `.env.development` and where production runs: the disk page cache outlives a restart.

templateFunctions.name: cspNonce
templateFunctions.doc: The response's Content-Security-Policy nonce, for an inline script or style: `<script nonce="{{cspNonce}}">`. Fresh on every response, even for a cached page.

collage-secure inline script.description: collage-secure: an inline script allowed by the Content-Security-Policy

config.description: A collage plugin that sends the security headers a site should, and a Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonces.

csp.description: CSP is the Content-Security-Policy. "{nonce}" in it is replaced by the response's nonce, which {{cspNonce}} puts on the page's inline scripts and styles. Empty sends none.

cspReportOnly.description: CSPReportOnly sends the policy as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only: violations are reported, nothing is blocked. In development the policy is always report-only, so collage's own reload script keeps working.

hsts.description: HSTS is how long, in seconds, a browser should use only HTTPS for the site, sent on requests that arrived over TLS — directly or, by X-Forwarded-Proto, through a proxy (collage.IsHTTPS: one listed in Server.TrustedProxies when any are). Default two years; negative sends none.

hstsSubdomains.description: HSTSSubdomains and HSTSPreload add includeSubDomains and preload.

keyEnv.description: KeyEnv names the environment variable holding the key, hex-encoded. When set, it wins over Key, and an empty or non-hex variable is an error.

permissionsPolicy.description: PermissionsPolicy is Permissions-Policy: "camera=(), microphone=()". Empty sends none.
